local theme={s="cards"}
local function light(c) return c==color.YELLOW or c==color.WHITE end
local function inkOf(c)
if c==color.ACCENT then return color.ACCENT_INK elseif c==color.ACCENT_INK then return color.ACCENT end
return light(c) and color.BLACK or color.WHITE
end
local tiles,raw,pts={},nil,{}
local function tileInk(x,y,c,fill)
if theme.s~="klar" then return c end
if (not fill or c~=color.WHITE) and #pts<400 then pts[#pts+1]=x; pts[#pts+1]=y end
for i=#tiles,1,-1 do
local t=tiles[i]
if x>=t[1] and x<t[3] and y>=t[2] and y<t[4] then
local f,i=t[5],t[6]
if c==f or (f==color.ACCENT and c==color.ACCENT_TEXT) then return i end
if c==color.BLACK and not fill and not light(f) and f~=color.ACCENT_INK then return i end
if c==color.ACCENT_INK and f~=color.ACCENT then return light(f) and color.BLACK or color.WHITE end
return c
end
end
return c
end
local function klarHook()
if raw then return end
raw={text=draw.text,wrap=draw.wrap,line=draw.line,rect=draw.rect,circle=draw.circle,triangle=draw.triangle,icon=draw.icon}
draw.text=function(x,y,s,f,c,...) return raw.text(x,y,s,f,tileInk(x,y - 4,c),...) end
draw.wrap=function(x,y,w,s,f,c,...) return raw.wrap(x,y,w,s,f,tileInk(x,y,c),...) end
draw.line=function(a,b,c2,d,c) return raw.line(a,b,c2,d,tileInk((a+c2)//2,(b+d)//2,c)) end
draw.circle=function(x,y,r,c,f)
c=tileInk(x,y,c,f)
if f and theme.s=="klar" and r>=8 and #tiles<120 then tiles[#tiles+1]={x - r,y - r,x+r,y+r,c,inkOf(c)} end
return raw.circle(x,y,r,c,f)
end
draw.triangle=function(a,b,c2,d,e,f,c,fl) return raw.triangle(a,b,c2,d,e,f,tileInk((a+c2+e)//3,(b+d+f)//3,c),fl) end
draw.icon=function(n,x,y,z,c) return raw.icon(n,x,y,z,tileInk(x+z//2,y+z//2,c)) end
draw.rect=function(x,y,w,h,c,fill,r)
c=tileInk(x+w//2,y+h//2,c,fill)
if fill and theme.s=="klar" and w>=16 and h>=12 and #tiles<120 then tiles[#tiles+1]={x,y,x+w,y+h,c,inkOf(c)} end
return raw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,fill,r)
end
end
local function setStyle(s)
theme.s=s or "cards"
tiles,pts={},{}
if theme.s=="klar" then klarHook() end
if theme.s=="relief" or theme.s=="klar" then return "cards" end
return s
end
local function card(x,y,w,h,c,r,nobar)
if theme.s=="relief" then
r=r or 12
draw.rect(x+6,y+6,w,h,color.BLACK,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.WHITE,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
draw.rect(x+1,y+1,w - 2,h - 2,color.BLACK,false,r)
return
elseif theme.s=="klar" then
if not c or c==color.BLACK then c=color.ACCENT end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,math.min((r or 18)+8,30))
return
end
r=r or 10
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.WHITE,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
if not nobar then draw.rect(x+6,y+6,5,h - 12,c or color.ACCENT,true,2) end
end
local function panel(x,y,w,h,r,c)
c=c or color.BLACK
local big=w>=60 and h>=30
if theme.s=="relief" and big then
local s=5
local rr=math.max(2,math.min(r or 12,40,w//2,h//2))
local function sichel(cx,cy,a0,a1)
local n=5
for i=0,n - 1 do
local u,v=math.rad(a0+(a1 - a0)*i/n),math.rad(a0+(a1 - a0)*(i+1)/n)
local c1,s1,c2,s2=math.cos(u)*rr,math.sin(u)*rr,math.cos(v)*rr,math.sin(v)*rr
local function f(v) return math.floor(v+0.5) end
draw.polygon({f(cx+c1),f(cy+s1),f(cx+c1+s),f(cy+s1+s),f(cx+c2+s),f(cy+s2+s),f(cx+c2),f(cy+s2)},color.BLACK,true)
end
end
draw.rect(x+w,y+rr,s,h - 2*rr+s,color.BLACK,true)
draw.rect(x+rr,y+h,w - 2*rr+s,s,color.BLACK,true)
sichel(x+w - rr,y+h - rr,0,90)
sichel(x+w - rr,y+rr,-45,0)
sichel(x+rr,y+h - rr,90,135)
end
if theme.s=="klar" and big then
c=c==color.BLACK and color.ACCENT or c
for i=1,#pts,2 do
if pts[i]>x and pts[i]<x+w and pts[i+1]>y and pts[i+1]<y+h then
for k=0,2 do draw.rect(x+k,y+k,w - 2*k,h - 2*k,c,false,r) end
return
end
end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,math.min((r or 12)+8,30))
return
end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,false,r)
end
local function widgetFrame(box)
if theme.s~="relief" and theme.s~="klar" then return box end
local x,y,w,h=box.x+4,box.y+2,box.w - 14,box.h - 12
card(x,y,w,h,color.ACCENT,theme.s=="relief" and 12 or 18)
local pad=theme.s=="relief" and 14 or 8
local inner={}
for k,v in pairs(box) do inner[k]=v end
inner.x,inner.y,inner.w,inner.h=box.x+pad,box.y+8,box.w - pad - 16,box.h - 20
return inner
end
local function pillW(txt,font,h,minw)
return math.max(minw or 0,draw.measure(txt,font or "small")+h)
end
local function pill(x,y,w,h,c,txt,font,tc)
if txt then w=pillW(txt,font,h,w) end
local r=h//2
c=c or color.ACCENT
if theme.s=="relief" then
draw.rect(x+3,y+3,w,h,color.BLACK,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
elseif theme.s=="klar" then
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,r)
else
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,false,r)
tc=tc or (c==color.ACCENT and color.ACCENT_TEXT or c)
end
if txt then draw.text(x+w//2,y+h//2+8,txt,font or "small",tc or (c==color.ACCENT and color.ACCENT_INK or color.WHITE),"center") end
return w
end
local function pbar(x,y,w,h,frac,c)
frac=math.max(0,math.min(1,frac or 0))
c=c or color.ACCENT
local r=h//2
if theme.s=="relief" then draw.rect(x+3,y+3,w,h,color.BLACK,true,r) ; draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.WHITE,true,r) end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
local fw=math.floor((w - 4)*frac)
if fw>h - 4 then draw.rect(x+2,y+2,fw,h - 4,c,true,(h - 4)//2)
elseif fw>2 then draw.rect(x+2,y+2,fw,h - 4,c,true) end
end
local NAS_FILE="einkauf.txt"
local TOMB_SEC=7*86400
local MAX_BYTES=20000
local function T(ctx,de,en) return (ctx.lang=="en") and en or de end
local function parse(text)
local m={}
if text then
for line in text:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
local f={}
for x in (line.."\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do f[#f+1]=x end
if f[1]~="" and f[2] and f[2]:match("^%d+$") and f[3] and f[3]:match("^%d$") then
m[f[1]]={id=f[1],ts=tonumber(f[2]),st=tonumber(f[3]),text=f[4] or "",
qty=f[5] or "",unit=f[6] or "",note=f[7] or "",link=f[8] or "",img=f[9] or ""}
end
end
end
return m
end
local function serialize(m,now,cleanup)
local list={}
for _,e in pairs(m) do
if e.st==1 and cleanup>0 and now - e.ts>cleanup then e.st=2; e.ts=now end
if not (e.st==2 and now - e.ts>TOMB_SEC) then list[#list+1]=e end
end
table.sort(list,function(a,b) if a.ts~=b.ts then return a.ts<b.ts end return a.id<b.id end)
local function join()
local out={}
for i=1,#list do local e=list[i]; out[i]=string.format("%s\t%d\t%d\t%s",e.id,e.ts,e.st,e.text)
if (e.qty or "")~="" or (e.unit or "")~="" or (e.note or "")~="" or (e.link or "")~="" or (e.img or "")~="" then
out[i]=out[i]..string.format("\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s",e.qty or "",e.unit or "",e.note or "",e.link or "",e.img or "")
end
end
return table.concat(out,"\n")
end
local s=join()
local i=1
while #s>MAX_BYTES and i<=#list do
if list[i].st~=0 then table.remove(list,i); s=join() else i=i+1 end
end
return s
end
local function merge(a,b)
for id,e in pairs(b) do
local x=a[id]
if x==nil or e.ts>x.ts then a[id]=e end
end
end
local function visible(m)
local open,done={},{}
for _,e in pairs(m) do
if e.st==0 then open[#open+1]=e elseif e.st==1 then done[#done+1]=e end
end
local f=function(a,b) if a.ts~=b.ts then return a.ts<b.ts end return a.id<b.id end
table.sort(open,f)
table.sort(done,function(a,b) if a.ts~=b.ts then return a.ts>b.ts end return a.id<b.id end)
for i=1,#done do open[#open+1]=done[i] end
return open,#open - #done,#done
end
local function load_local() return parse(file.read("items")) end
local function now_ts()
local n=time.now()
return n or 0
end
local function new_id(ctx)
local s=system.get()
local room=(s and s.room or "x"):sub(1,2)
local c=(tonumber(ctx.data.get("seq")) or 0)+1
ctx.data.set("seq",c%4096)
return string.format("%s%x%x",room,now_ts(),c)
end
local function cleanup_sec(ctx)
local h=tonumber(ctx.cfg and ctx.cfg.cleanup) or 24
return h*3600
end
local function clean_field(t,max)
t=tostring(t or ""):gsub("[%c]"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
if #t>max then
local i=max
while i>1 and (t:byte(i+1) or 0) & 0xC0==0x80 do i=i - 1 end
t=t:sub(1,i)
end
return t
end
local function clean_text(t) return clean_field(t,60) end
local function clean_url(t)
t=tostring(t or ""):gsub("[%c%s]","")
if #t>300 or not (t:match("^https?://[^/]")~=nil) then return "" end
return t
end
local function fields(q)
return clean_field(q.qty,8),clean_field(q.unit,12),clean_field(q.note,200),clean_url(q.link),clean_url(q.img)
end
local function label(e)
local a=e.qty or ""
if a=="" then return e.text end
if (e.unit or "")~="" then a=a.." "..e.unit end
return a.." "..e.text
end
function on_fetch(ctx)
local now=now_ts()
local m=load_local()
local pend=ctx.data.get("pend")
if pend and pend~="" then
for id in tostring(pend):gmatch("[^;]+") do
local e=m[id]
if e and e.st~=2 then e.st=(e.st==0) and 1 or 0; e.ts=now end
end
ctx.data.set("pend","")
end
local sync="local"
local cl=cleanup_sec(ctx)
if storage.ready() then
local remote,err=storage.read("dir",NAS_FILE)
local rm
if remote==nil and err=="nicht gefunden" then remote=""; end
if remote~=nil then
rm=parse(remote)
merge(m,rm)
local s=serialize(m,now,cl)
if s~=remote then
local ok=storage.write("dir",NAS_FILE,s)
sync=ok and "ok" or "error"
else
sync="ok"
end
else
sync="error"
end
end
local s=serialize(m,now,cl)
file.write("items",s)
ctx.data.set("sync",sync)
if sync=="ok" then ctx.data.set("syncAt",now) end
local _,open,done=visible(m)
ctx.data.set("open",open)
ctx.data.set("done",done)
ctx.data.set("rev",(tonumber(ctx.data.get("rev")) or 0)+1)
return true
end
local function esc(t)
return (tostring(t):gsub('[%c"\\]',function(c)
if c=='"' then return '\\"' elseif c=="\\" then return "\\\\" end
return " "
end))
end
local function reply(status,body) return {status=status,body=body} end
local REPLY_BUDGET=15000
local function list_json(ctx,m,full)
local v,open,done=visible(m)
local parts={}
local sync=ctx.data.get("sync") or "local"
local tail=string.format(',"open":%d,"done":%d,"sync":"%s","nas":%s',open,done,esc(sync),sync~="local" and "true" or "false")
local extra=""
if full then
local live,tombs={},{}
for _,e in pairs(m) do
if e.st==2 then
tombs[#tombs+1]=string.format('{"id":"%s","ts":%d,"st":2,"text":"","qty":"","unit":"","note":"","link":"","img":""}',esc(e.id),e.ts)
else
live[#live+1]=string.format('{"id":"%s","ts":%d,"st":%d,"text":"%s","qty":"%s","unit":"%s","note":"%s","link":"%s","img":"%s"}',esc(e.id),e.ts,e.st,esc(e.text),esc(e.qty or ""),esc(e.unit or ""),esc(e.note or ""),esc(e.link or ""),esc(e.img or ""))
end
end
local ents,size={},#tail+40
for _,list in ipairs({live,tombs}) do
for i=1,#list do
if size+#list[i]+1>REPLY_BUDGET then break end
ents[#ents+1]=list[i]; size=size+#list[i]+1
end
end
extra=',"entries":['..table.concat(ents,",")..']'
return '{"items":[]'..tail..extra..'}'
end
for i=1,#v do
local e=v[i]
parts[i]=string.format('{"id":"%s","text":"%s","done":%s,"qty":"%s","unit":"%s","note":"%s","link":"%s","img":"%s"}',esc(e.id),esc(e.text),e.st==1 and "true" or "false",esc(e.qty or ""),esc(e.unit or ""),esc(e.note or ""),esc(e.link or ""),esc(e.img or ""))
end
return '{"items":['..table.concat(parts,",")..']'..tail..'}'
end
function on_http(ctx,req)
local q=json.decode(req.body or "")
if type(q)~="table" then return reply(400,'{"error":"JSON"}') end
local op=tostring(q.op or "list")
local m=load_local()
local now=now_ts()
local changed=false
if op=="add" then
local t=clean_text(q.text)
if t=="" then return reply(400,'{"error":"leer"}') end
local id=new_id(ctx)
local qty,unit,note,link,img=fields(q)
m[id]={id=id,ts=now,st=0,text=t,qty=qty,unit=unit,note=note,link=link,img=img}
changed=true
elseif op=="edit" then
local e=m[tostring(q.id or "")]
local t=clean_text(q.text)
if e and e.st~=2 and t~="" then
e.text=t; e.qty,e.unit,e.note,e.link,e.img=fields(q); e.ts=now; changed=true
end
elseif op=="toggle" then
local e=m[tostring(q.id or "")]
if e and e.st~=2 then e.st=(e.st==0) and 1 or 0; e.ts=now; changed=true end
elseif op=="del" then
local e=m[tostring(q.id or "")]
if e then e.st=2; e.ts=now; changed=true end
elseif op=="clear" then
for _,e in pairs(m) do if e.st==1 then e.st=2; e.ts=now; changed=true end end
elseif op=="sync" then
local inc=q.entries
if type(inc)=="table" then
for i=1,#inc do
local x=inc[i]
if type(x)=="table" and x.id~=nil then
local id=tostring(x.id):gsub("[%c]","")
local ts=tonumber(x.ts) or 0
local st=tonumber(x.st) or 0
if now>0 and ts>now+86400 then ts=now end
local tx=clean_text(x.text)
if id~="" and #id<=24 and (st==0 or st==1 or st==2) and (tx~="" or st==2) then
local cur=m[id]
if cur==nil or ts>cur.ts then
local qty,unit,note,link,img=fields(x)
m[id]={id=id,ts=ts,st=st,text=tx,qty=qty,unit=unit,note=note,link=link,img=img}
changed=true
end
end
end
end
end
end
if changed then
file.write("items",serialize(m,now,cleanup_sec(ctx)))
local _,open,done=visible(m)
ctx.data.set("open",open)
ctx.data.set("done",done)
ctx.data.set("rev",(tonumber(ctx.data.get("rev")) or 0)+1)
local r=reply(200,list_json(ctx,m,op=="sync"))
r.fetch=true
r.redraw=true
return r
end
return reply(200,list_json(ctx,m,op=="sync"))
end
function on_input(ctx,kind,n)
local m=load_local()
local v=visible(m)
local total=#v+1
if #v==0 then return false end
local sel=tonumber(ctx.data.get("sel")) or 0
if kind=="click" then
if ctx.data.get("browse")~=1 then return false end
if sel>=#v then
ctx.data.set("browse",0)
return true
end
local e=v[sel+1]
if e then
local p=tostring(ctx.data.get("pend") or "")
ctx.data.set("pend",p..e.id..";")
return "fetch"
end
return true
end
if ctx.data.get("browse")~=1 then sel=0 end
ctx.data.set("browse",1)
ctx.data.set("sel",(sel+math.floor(n))%total)
return true
end
local function cut(text,maxw,font)
while #text>1 and draw.measure(text,font)>maxw do
local i=#text
while i>1 and (text:byte(i) & 0xC0)==0x80 do i=i - 1 end
text=text:sub(1,i - 1)
end
return text
end
local function tick(x,y,s,col)
draw.line(x+s//5,y+s//2,x+s*2//5,y+s*4//5,col)
draw.line(x+s*2//5,y+s*4//5,x+s*4//5,y+s//5,col)
draw.line(x+s//5,y+s//2+1,x+s*2//5,y+s*4//5+1,col)
draw.line(x+s*2//5,y+s*4//5+1,x+s*4//5,y+s//5+1,col)
end
local function checkbox(x,y,s,done)
if done then
draw.rect(x,y,s,s,color.GREEN,true,5)
panel(x,y,s,s,5)
tick(x,y,s,color.BLACK)
else
panel(x,y,s,s,5)
end
end
local function sync_text(ctx)
local s=ctx.data.get("sync")
if s=="ok" then return T(ctx,"synchronisiert","synced") end
if s=="error" then return T(ctx,"Sync-Fehler","sync error") end
return T(ctx,"nicht synchronisiert","not synced")
end
function on_draw(ctx,page)
local style=setStyle(ctx.cfg.style) or "cards"
draw.clear(color.WHITE)
local m=load_local()
local v,open,done=visible(m)
local y0=draw.top
if #v==0 then
if device.qrscreen and device.qrscreen(T(ctx,"Einkaufsliste ist leer","Shopping list is empty"),T(ctx,"QR-Code scannen und Dinge hinzufügen:","Scan the QR code to add items:")) then return end
draw.text(draw.width//2,y0+150,T(ctx,"Einkaufsliste ist leer","Shopping list is empty"),"large",color.BLACK,"center")
return
end
local compact=(style=="compact")
if compact then
local keep={}
for i=1,#v do if v[i].st==0 then keep[#keep+1]=v[i] end end
if #keep>0 then v=keep end
end
draw.text(28,y0+36,T(ctx,"Einkaufsliste","Shopping list"),"large",color.BLACK,"left")
draw.text(draw.width - 28,y0+22,string.format(T(ctx,"%d offen","%d open"),open)..(done>0 and string.format(T(ctx,", %d erledigt",", %d done"),done) or ""),"normal",color.BLACK,"right")
draw.text(draw.width - 28,y0+42,sync_text(ctx),"small",color.BLACK,"right")
local rowH=compact and 56 or 46
local top=y0+56
local browse=ctx.data.get("browse")==1
local sel=browse and (tonumber(ctx.data.get("sel")) or 0) or -1
local bottom=draw.height - 30
local rows=(bottom - top)//rowH
local total=#v+(browse and 1 or 0)
local start=0
if sel>=rows then start=sel - rows+1 end
if sel<0 and total>rows then rows=rows end
local font=compact and "large" or "normal"
for r=0,rows - 1 do
local i=start+r+1
if i>total then break end
local y=top+r*rowH
local isSel=(i - 1==sel)
if browse and i==#v+1 then
panel(24,y+2,draw.width - 48,rowH - 6,10)
if isSel then draw.rect(24,y+2,draw.width - 48,rowH - 6,color.YELLOW,true,10) ; panel(24,y+2,draw.width - 48,rowH - 6,10) end
draw.text(draw.width//2,y+rowH//2+6,T(ctx,"Fertig","Done"),"normal",color.BLACK,"center")
else
local e=v[i]
local isDone=e.st==1
if style=="cards" or isSel then
if isSel then draw.rect(24,y+2,draw.width - 48,rowH - 6,color.YELLOW,true,10) end
panel(24,y+2,draw.width - 48,rowH - 6,10)
elseif style=="flat" then
draw.line(28,y+rowH - 2,draw.width - 28,y+rowH - 2,color.BLACK)
end
local bs=compact and 32 or 26
checkbox(42,y+(rowH - bs)//2,bs,isDone)
local tx=42+bs+16
local text=cut(label(e),draw.width - tx - 44,font)
draw.text(tx,y+rowH//2+(compact and 9 or 7),text,font,color.BLACK,"left")
if isDone then
local w=draw.measure(text,font)
draw.line(tx,y+rowH//2+1,tx+w,y+rowH//2+1,color.BLACK)
end
end
end
local more=total - (start+rows)
local foot
if browse then foot=T(ctx,"Drehen: wählen   Klick: abhaken","Turn: select   Click: tick off")
elseif more>0 then foot=string.format(T(ctx,"+ %d weitere","+ %d more"),more)
else
local u=device.url and device.url() or nil
foot=u and (T(ctx,"Handy: ","Phone: ")..u) or ""
end
draw.text(28,draw.height - 10,cut(foot,draw.width - 56,"small"),"small",color.BLACK,"left")
end
function on_widget(ctx,box)
setStyle(ctx.cfg.style)
box=widgetFrame(box)
local style=setStyle(ctx.cfg.style) or "cards"
local m=load_local()
local v,open,done=visible(m)
local cx=box.x+box.w//2
if #v==0 then
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h//2+6,T(ctx,"Liste leer","List empty"),"normal",color.BLACK,"center")
return
end
local small=box.h<90
local lh=small and 19 or 26
local font=small and "small" or "normal"
local bs=small and 12 or 18
local left=0
if style=="compact" and box.w>=150 and box.h>=44 then
left=52
draw.text(box.x+left//2,box.y+box.h//2+6,tostring(open),"large",open>0 and color.BLACK or color.GREEN,"center")
draw.text(box.x+left//2,box.y+box.h//2+22,T(ctx,"offen","open"),"small",color.BLACK,"center")
draw.line(box.x+left+2,box.y+8,box.x+left+2,box.y+box.h - 8,color.BLACK)
end
local rows=(box.h - 6)//lh
if rows<1 then
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h//2+10,tostring(open),"huge",open>0 and color.BLACK or color.GREEN,"center")
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h - 6,T(ctx,"offen","open"),"small",color.BLACK,"center")
return
end
local shown=0
local tx=box.x+left+8+bs+8
for i=1,#v do
if shown>=rows then break end
if v[i].st==0 then
local y=box.y+4+shown*lh
checkbox(box.x+left+8,y+(lh - bs)//2,bs,false)
draw.text(tx,y+lh//2+(small and 4 or 6),cut(label(v[i]),box.x+box.w - tx - 8,font),font,color.BLACK,"left")
shown=shown+1
end
end
if open>shown and shown>0 then
draw.text(box.x+box.w - 8,box.y+box.h - 4,string.format("+%d",open - shown),"small",color.BLACK,"right")
end
if open==0 then
local msg=T(ctx,"Alles erledigt","All done")
local f="large"
for _,c in ipairs({"large","medium","normal","small"}) do
f=c
if draw.measure(msg,c)<=box.w - 12 then break end
end
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h//2+6,msg,f,color.GREEN,"center")
end
end

help.de: Mit externem Speicher (Einstellungen → Speicher; FTP, WebDAV oder Google Drive) zeigen alle InkBoards im Netzwerk dieselbe Liste: Jeder Eintrag liegt mit Zeitstempel in einer gemeinsamen Datei, der neuere gewinnt. Ohne externen Speicher arbeitet die Liste nur auf diesem Gerät. Die Mac- und iOS-App halten außerdem eine eigene Kopie, die offline gepflegt und alle 20 Minuten mit dem Gerät abgeglichen wird.
help.en: With external storage (Settings → Storage; FTP, WebDAV or Google Drive) all InkBoards in the network show the same list: every entry is kept with a time stamp in a shared file and the newer one wins. Without external storage the list only works on this device. The Mac and iOS apps also keep their own copy that can be edited offline and is synced with the device every 20 minutes.

help.de: App-Speicher: ein eigener, getrennter Speicher (FTP, WebDAV oder Google Drive) nur für Apps, z. B. wenn der Hauptspeicher nur im Heimnetz erreichbar ist. Einrichten unter Einstellungen → App-Speicher.
help.en: App storage: a separate storage (FTP, WebDAV or Google Drive) just for apps, e.g. when the main storage is only reachable at home. Set it up under Settings → App storage.

help.de: Alle InkBoards mit demselben Ordner teilen sich die Liste.
help.en: All InkBoards with the same folder share the list.
